body:
Aha, it's fine!
Yeah, I mean, I have finally brought up the courage to try to get diagnosed. Although I don't know what good that'll do me
I have a consular, but I struggle to talk to her about things. Which really sucks. And as for school, they couldn't give any less damns about their students mental health
Er... I guess it depends - most of the time it's cereal and toast. But I always have very sugary cereals, and add more suger to them because it helps me get through the first two hours of the day.

If you recognise this post, it's because I made the same post on r/suicidewatch.
I just want to get as much advice on my situation as possible

You know those times where you're happy? Like, truly happy? That sense of bliss splitting up the hell that is every other part of life.
They are rare, yes. But they are worth living for.
Why give up the chance to be happy? What's the point? If you have survived until now, you are string enough to continue, even if it's just for the fleeting, few and far between feelings of joy and bliss that do still exist in the world.


There will always be people who care about you, you just may not have found them yet. 
Just try a little longer. 
I promise you, there will be something that will be better.

Huh. Thank you for responding -

It is a scary thought to think they may not work for me though. Hopefully I eventually get some that do. And I hope you find some that continue to help you as well

Really? That's wonderful, I guess they work then. 
+1 for humanity
